data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Stale-sync manifest lists each entry at bridge_state/bootstrap/stale-syncs-<pass>.manifest.json

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/stale_band.py with plan subcommand. Accepts --pass <N>. Calls enumerate_stale_anomalies() (from task-2), then AcliClient.get_issue_property() to materialize each entry as {jira_key, current_label_id, current_property_id, authoritative_local_id, needs_review: bool}. Sets needs_review=true for entries crossing a known ID-space boundary (risk flag from Considerations). Writes manifest to bridge_state/bootstrap/stale-syncs-<pass>.manifest.json. Pure read+serialize, no Jira mutations.

## TDD Test Spec
Given 3 stale anomalies (1 crossing ID-space boundary) and AcliClient stub returning predictable get_issue_property values; When plan --pass 001 invoked; Then manifest contains 3 entries with required keys, boundary-crossing entry has needs_review=true, others have needs_review=false. Plan exits non-zero when AcliClient.get_issue_property raises.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Implement stale_band.py plan subcommand writing stale-syncs-<pass>.manifest.json
